name: Belmond Casa de Sierra Nevada
positioning: Heritage hotel (Casa de Sierra Nevada, A Belmond Hotel) spread across six historic casonas in central San Miguel de Allende
best_for: Travelers who want a historic casona stay in the center of San Miguel de Allende
Guests who enjoy cooking classes and a small spa

facts.text: The hotel is in central San Miguel de Allende, a UNESCO World Heritage site.
The hotel is spread across six historic casonas.
The architecture is adorned with ancient masonry, Aztec motifs and baroque details.
The Blue Bar offers live music and drinks.
The hotel has a 24-hour fitness studio.
The hotel is in the city that enchanted Frida Kahlo and Diego Rivera.
The hotel is a 3.5 hour drive from Mexico City.
The hotel is a 1.5 hour drive from Queretaro airport.
Conde Nast Traveler lists the hotel in its Gold List 2024.

highlights.text: The 16th-century Casa Principal was once home to an archbishop, and the 17th-century Casa Parque was a former fort.
Tunki Rooftop, run with Handshake, serves Peruvian-inflected tapas.
Sazon Cooking School offers expert-led classes in regional Mexican specialties.
Laja Spa offers therapies influenced by the lessons of the natural world.

considerations.text: The spa is small, with three treatment rooms.
The hotel has a small pool in a courtyard.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
